title: Looking for Advice on Growing an Open-Source Cybersecurity Project
content_md:
Hey everyone, I've been working in cybersecurity for the last 5 years, and over the past year I've been building a project called Vader-Pro-VDR, an AI-assisted Vulnerability Detection & Remediation platform. So far, I've built: A Go-based endpoint agent that collects system and software inventory information. A backend API that receives and processes agent data. AWS-hosted infrastructure for communication between endpoints and the backend. A working proof of concept that can identify installed applications and their versions across endpoints. My long-term vision is to build a platform that can: Continuously identify vulnerable software and configurations. Correlate findings with CVE intelligence. Use AI agents to provide remediation recommendations. Eventually automate certain remediation
